quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: From identifying promising technologies to creating new (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supplier FemtoMetrix (an SK hynix Ventures portfolio company): SK Hynix's mass-production and R&D teams evaluated FemtoMetrix's Second Harmonic Generation (SHG) technology -- which uses light to measure the properties of interfaces between materials such as silicon and silicon oxide without damaging the wafer, enabling nondestructive analysis inside stacked structures -- by applying it to DRAM and HBM processes; after confirming its applicability SK Hynix moved forward with equipment adoption and has decided to install multiple tools per fab.

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: From identifying promising technologies to creating new (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Infinitesima (an SK hynix Ventures portfolio company): Infinitesima developed Rapid Probe Microscope (RPM) technology that, per the release, delivers measurement speeds 10 to 100 times faster than conventional Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM); SK Hynix applied it to pattern monitoring in its DRAM manufacturing processes and has confirmed plans to deploy multiple systems.
quarterly_data.figure: RPM measurement speed 10 to 100 times faster than conventional AFM
